tasks.label: pdq-authorize-probe
tasks.command: $base='https://auth2.pdq.com/oauth/authorize'; $client='c9403ceb-ba30-4e2d-9cef-7a2884b7452b'; $redir='http://localhost:3000/oauth/callback'; $state='debugstate'; $cc='abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789ABCDEFG'; $tests=@('openid profile pdq.connect','devices:read groups:read deployments:read'); foreach($scope in $tests){ $uri = "$base?response_type=code&client_id=$([uri]::EscapeDataString($client))&redirect_uri=$([uri]::EscapeDataString($redir))&scope=$([uri]::EscapeDataString($scope))&state=$state&code_challenge=$cc&code_challenge_method=S256"; try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $uri -MaximumRedirection 0 -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('SCOPE='+$scope); Write-Output ('STATUS='+[int]$r.StatusCode) } catch { $resp=$_.Exception.Response; if($resp){ Write-Output ('SCOPE='+$scope); Write-Output ('STATUS='+[int]$resp.StatusCode); try { $sr=[System.IO.StreamReader]::new($resp.GetResponseStream()); $body=$sr.ReadToEnd(); $sr.Dispose(); Write-Output ('BODY='+($body.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(180,$body.Length)).Replace("`r",' ').Replace("`n",' '))) } catch {} } else { Write-Output ('SCOPE='+$scope); Write-Output ('ERROR='+$_.Exception.Message) } }; Write-Output '---' }

tasks.label: port-3000-owner
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess,@{n='ProcessName';e={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: port-3000-owner-check2
tasks.command: $rows = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($rows){ $rows | Select-Object State,LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess,@{n='ProcessName';e={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName}} | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { 'No active TCP bindings on port 3000.' }

tasks.label: list-tavily-tool-names
tasks.command: Import-Module .\TechToolbox.psd1 -Force; & (Get-Module TechToolbox) { Initialize-TechToolboxRuntime; $agent=$script:cfg.settings.agent; $mcp=Get-TTAgentConfigValue -ConfigObject $agent -KeyName 'mcp'; $server=@(Get-TTAgentConfigValue -ConfigObject $mcp -KeyName 'servers') | Where-Object { [string]::Equals([string](Get-TTAgentConfigValue -ConfigObject $_ -KeyName 'name'),'tavily',[System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) } | Select-Object -First 1; $single=[ordered]@{ enabled=$true; servers=@($server) }; $json=$single|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 64 -Compress; [void][System.Reflection.Assembly]::LoadFrom((Join-Path $script:ModuleRoot 'src\TechToolbox.Agent\bin\Release\net8.0\publish\TechToolbox.Agent.dll')); $mcpType=[Type]::GetType('TechToolbox.Agent.Configuration.McpConfiguration, TechToolbox.Agent',$true); $agentType=[Type]::GetType('TechToolbox.Agent.Configuration.AgentConfiguration, TechToolbox.Agent',$true); $modeType=[Type]::GetType('TechToolbox.Agent.Configuration.AgentMode, TechToolbox.Agent',$true); $bootType=[Type]::GetType('TechToolbox.Agent.Mcp.McpBootstrap, TechToolbox.Agent',$true); $opts=[System.Text.Json.JsonSerializerOptions]::new(); $opts.PropertyNameCaseInsensitive=$true; $opts.Converters.Add([System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonStringEnumConverter]::new()); $mcpCfg=[System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer]::Deserialize($json,$mcpType,$opts); $mode=[System.Enum]::Parse($modeType,'TechToolbox'); $cfg=$agentType.GetMethod('CreateForMode',[type[]]@($modeType)).Invoke($null,@($mode)); $cfg.Mcp=$mcpCfg; $runtime=$bootType.GetMethod('InitializeAsync',[type[]]@($agentType,[System.Threading.CancellationToken])).Invoke($null,@($cfg,[System.Threading.CancellationToken]::None)).GetAwaiter().GetResult(); foreach($p in @($runtime.Providers)){ foreach($t in @($p.DiscoverTools())){ $t.Name } }; $runtime.DisposeAsync().AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult() }
